description: 混雑したカフェで、若い男性客が人とぶつかってトレーを落としてしまい、飲み物や食べ物が床に散らばっている。男性は驚き、店員が急いでモップと布を持って片づけようとしている。近くの女性客は椅子を動かして通路を空け、別の客が落ちた財布を拾って男性に渡そうとしている。背景では、子どもがアイスクリームを服に落として泣きそうになり、別の女性は注文した飲み物を取り違えて困っている。さらに、ノートパソコンで作業していた男性がこぼれた飲み物からパソコンを守ろうと慌てて持ち上げ、入口付近では高齢者が重いドアを開けるのに苦労している。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show a busy modern cafe during a crowded afternoon. The main event must be very clear in the foreground: a young male customer has accidentally collided with another person while carrying a tray, causing the tray, two drinks, a sandwich, napkins, and a small plate to fall onto the floor. One paper cup has tipped over and liquid is spreading across the floor. The young man looks shocked, embarrassed, and apologetic. A cafe employee is approaching quickly with a mop and cleaning cloth to deal with the spill. A female customer nearby is moving her chair out of the way to create more space. Another customer has noticed that the young man's wallet fell from his pocket and is bending down to pick it up and return it to him. Include several clear background sub-stories. On the left, a small child has accidentally dropped ice cream onto the front of his clothes and looks close to tears while a parent tries to help him. At the counter, a confused woman is holding a drink and comparing it with her receipt because she appears to have received the wrong order. At a nearby table, a man who was working on a laptop is urgently lifting the computer away from the edge of the table because spilled liquid is getting close to it. Near the entrance, an elderly customer carrying a shopping bag is struggling to open a heavy glass door, while another person is moving toward him to help. Include tables, chairs, coffee cups, trays, sandwiches, a cafe counter, menu boards with simple unreadable markings, a laptop, shopping bags, napkins, a mop, and several customers. Make every action visually distinct and easy to describe. Show clear foreground, middle ground, and background, approximately 10 to 13 visible people. No speech bubbles, no captions, no readable brand names, no copyrighted logos or characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, colorful clean educational illustration style, detailed but uncluttered, expressive faces and body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.
